summary: Air-gapped install: offline bundle preflight fails signature verification (x509 not-yet-valid due to clock skew)
description:
Issue summary
- Customer reports Redwood Private air-gapped install blocked during preflight: signature verification fails for the offline bundle.

Impact
- Install/upgrade blocked (fails closed). Pilot timeline at risk.
- No production outage; new cluster bring-up halted.

Customer / deployment context
- Customer: Helios Defense (Private, air-gapped on-prem)
- OS: RHEL 9.3 hardened image
- K8s: 1.28.4 (kubeadm), containerd 1.7.x
- Installer: redwood-private-installer v0.24.1 (linux-amd64)
- Offline bundle: redwood-private-offline-bundle 2026.01.0-build.117 (transported via encrypted USB)

Steps to reproduce (from customer)
1) Copy bundle to /mnt/media/redwood/bundles/redwood-private-2026.01.0-build.117.tgz
2) Extract: tar -xzf redwood-private-2026.01.0-build.117.tgz -C /opt/redwood/bundles/2026.01.0
3) Run: ./redwood-private-installer preflight --air-gapped --bundle-path /opt/redwood/bundles/2026.01.0

Observed result
- Preflight stops at "Verify bundle signature" with x509 time validity error.

Expected result
- Preflight verifies manifest signature successfully and continues.

Key logs (customer provided)
- /var/log/redwood-installer/installer.log:
  2026-01-07T19:12:44Z INFO  preflight: verifying offline bundle signature
  2026-01-07T19:12:44Z ERROR verify: bundle signature verification failed
  2026-01-07T19:12:44Z ERROR verify: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid: current time 2025-12-19T03:41:02Z is before 2026-01-03T00:00:00Z
  2026-01-07T19:12:44Z ERROR preflight: RW_BUNDLE_VERIFY_NOT_YET_VALID: signature validation failed (bundle=/opt/redwood/bundles/2026.01.0)

- /var/log/redwood-installer/audit.log:
  2026-01-07T19:12:44Z AUDIT bundle.verify result=fail reason=not_yet_valid bundle_build_id=2026.01.0-build.117 signer_key_id=rw-release-2025q4-01

Initial triage notes
- Error indicates installer system clock is behind the signing certificate validity window (not-yet-valid). Common in air-gapped environments without NTP.
- Need to confirm:
  (a) node time source and current date/time
  (b) whether customer can set time manually / via their approved time appliance
  (c) whether they are using any time virtualization/BIOS drift

Support asks / data requested
- Output of: date -u
- Output of: timedatectl status
- Output of: hwclock --show
- Confirm bundle extracted path contains: bundle.manifest.json and bundle.manifest.sig

Proposed remediation
- Correct system time on the jump host / installer host AND any nodes where installer runs verification.
- Re-run preflight.
- If time cannot be corrected immediately, use break-glass only if approved (not recommended; requires Security + customer sign-off) and capture audit evidence.

Attachments (customer)
- installer.log excerpt (sanitized)
- timedatectl output
- photo of rack time appliance status panel (pending)
comments:

Bundle: 2026.01.0-build.117

2026-01-08 00:12 UTC — Dev Patel (Assignee)

1) Update system time using approved source (their time appliance) on the machine running the installer.
2) Verify clock now >= 2026-01-03T00:00:00Z.
3) Re-run: redwood-private-installer preflight --air-gapped --bundle-path ...

Note: do NOT recommend break-glass override. If absolutely required, we need a written approval path + we must capture audit.log + support bundle.

Internal: This error message is not very actionable; point to PR-24973/PR-24961 improvements for clearer remediation and time-skew guidance.

Customer updated time per their SOP (time appliance). New date -u => 2026-01-08 18:40:09Z.

- "Verify bundle signature" => PASS

They asked if we can document "minimum time requirements" for air-gapped installs (e.g., must have a trusted time source).

2026-01-09 02:20 UTC — Dev Patel (Assignee)
Resolution for this ticket: time skew. Suggested doc update for air-gapped install guide: add prerequisite section for time source + how to diagnose not-yet-valid.

Logged follow-up to Docs/Eng via Slack (#support + #eng-private-deployments) to ensure guide includes:
- check date -u / timedatectl
- explanation of x509 not-yet-valid
- no-break-glass stance unless approved.

Closing as Resolved (customer unblocked).
resolution:
Root cause: installer host system clock was ~20 days behind (air-gapped environment with NTP disabled), causing x509 "not yet valid" failure during offline bundle manifest signature verification.

Fix/workaround applied:
- Customer corrected system time using their approved on-prem time appliance procedure.
- Re-ran installer preflight; signature verification passed and install proceeded.

Notes:
- Break-glass override was not used.
- Recommendation: ensure air-gapped installation prerequisites include a reliable time source (manual or appliance) before running verification.

Next steps (non-blocking):
- Improve error messaging and docs for time-skew scenarios (track in installer docs updates; see PR-24961/PR-24973).
